scope: B10 corrective token/accounting pass only; B10 live gates OPEN, no B11

execution.opt_in: Trusted explicit permit bound to one investigation and thread; CLI --live required even on resume
execution.ordinary_tests: Deny live permit and intercept external provider HTTP/DNS in parent and inherited Python children
execution.mock_permit: Requires actual httpx.MockTransport, never grants network permission
execution.live_suite: backend/tests/live; excluded from ordinary pytest; only separately approved operator invocation

context.facts: Full-content SHA256 references; distinct source versions never merged
context.history: Latest authoritative assessment plus all historical evidence classifications, provenance, paths, temporal references and limitations; full source histories retained in FalkorDB
context.catalog: All 16 approved tools, exact input schemas interned by content hash; no scenario-to-tool filter
context.overflow: Pause on finite token or durable journal budget, never silently drop decision-critical data
context.native_provider_cache: Disabled, no paid spike or claimed measured savings

read_cache.reuse: Return original validated result and original ToolExecution reference; no fabricated new execution
read_cache.invalidation: Any graph revision change, including host audit writes; stable revision required before and after call
read_cache.negatives: Bounded-negative, truncated, missing evidence and candidate/verified reservations retained; never proof of absence

spending.store: Private auxiliary SQLite WAL/FULL ledger, BEGIN IMMEDIATE; domain/evidence/checkpoints remain FalkorDB
spending.reserve: Dollar fence only: complete serialized input UTF8 bytes plus framing and doubled output price allowance; NOT token units. Counting RPC separately financially reserved; count result is not billing receipt.
spending.unknown_billing: Retain full reservation, do not treat as free; reconcile only from verified metadata
spending.over_reservation: Exact request hold; bound verified stored usage/pricing, operator/reason/evidence, repricing and cap checks, immutable recovery audit; no blanket clear
spending.idempotency: Thread/wake/decision/repair/retry ID, duplicate reservation denied, no blind rebilling after crash
spending.session_recovery: No automatic expiry takeover; stop old process, reconcile and release exact owner explicitly
spending.scope_limit: New managed requests only; historical/external billing unknown, not Google account billing hard cap
spending.existing_ledgers: Persisted caps, charges, unknown reservations and cases unchanged unless explicit audited operator action

provider_recovery.trace: Sanitized category, model/prompt/pricing versions, actual usage or uncertainty and durable reservation; never provider body/key or thought text

token_accounting.offline: Pinned official Gemma3 SentencePiece vocabulary: proxy for Gemini3.8, never exact; ceil(local count*1.25)+256 input margin plus4096 output
token_accounting.live: Requires explicit permit, accounted countTokens with full generateContentRequest and response schema; verified count+16 framing plus4096 output. Ordinary tests use no external counting. Result not billing proof.
token_accounting.unknown: Token allowance remains held until verified usage; durable per-thread floor prevents stale checkpoint reset
token_accounting.retry_repair: Each generation attempt independently reserves complete current-body input/output; actual usage replaces its allowance; bounded repair recounts changed body
token_accounting.resume: Trusted explicit reason and validated monotonic Budget increase on same paused thread; counters and source refresh retained
token_accounting.limits: Defaults unchanged60000tokens/16iterations/8tools/240seconds/5wakes; configurable within existing model bounds; StateGraph recursion150 bounds32iteration wakes
